interaction.prompt: You carry the puck up the middle on a 3-on-1 rush. Read the defender's position and tap the teammate with the open ice.

mc.stem: You carry the puck up the middle on a 3-on-1. The lone defender has stepped toward the LW side of the zone. What's the best play?
opts: Pass to the RW on the far side
Pass to the LW — they look to have a step at the top
Shoot — quick release before the goalie can set
Drive through the near side of the defender

feedback.right: Yes. The lone defender cannot cover both sides — when they shade to your left teammate, the right-side teammate is wide open for the pass.
feedback.wrong: The defender's position closes the LW lane. Shooting from traffic or driving into the defender wastes your 3-on-1 advantage — the RW has clear ice for a clean pass.

tip: On an odd-man rush, move the puck to the side the lone defender left open.
why: One defender can only take one threat. Reading which side they commit to, and passing away from it, is the whole odd-man read.
